integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from the standard compound-Poisson lattice characterization and Pringsheim theorem; exact checks independently confirm finite parameter cases but do not prove the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Integer shapes and strictly interior inflation/count parameters only; 1979 broad mixed-Poisson article unavailable in full; absolute novelty not certified.
title: Sharp infinite-divisibility threshold for zero-inflated negative-binomial laws of integer shape
